units.source_text: 前太政大臣本性多情善感，

en.t: The former Grand Minister was by nature deeply emotional and sensitive,

units.source_text: 看到这盖世无双的美人香消玉殒，不胜悼惜，

en.t: and when he saw this peerless beauty pass away, he grieved for her beyond measure,
and came many times to offer Genji his condolences.

units.source_text: 他回想昔年夕雾的母亲逝世，也是这时候的事，心中十分悲伤。

en.t: He remembered that Yugiri's mother had also died at this same season years before, and his heart was filled with sorrow.
At dusk he sank into deep thought:

units.source_text: “当时悼惜她的人，像父亲左大臣及母亲太君等，多数不在人间了。

en.t: "Those who mourned her then, such as her father, the Minister of the Left, and her mother, are mostly no longer in this world.

units.source_text: 短命或长年，相差实在无几，真乃无常迅速啊！”

en.t: Whether life is short or long, there is really little difference; how swiftly all things pass away!"

units.source_text: 暮色苍茫，催人哀思，他就写了一封信，遣儿子藏人少将致送源氏。

en.t: As the dusk spread dimly and stirred his grief, he wrote a letter and sent his son, the Chamberlain Lesser Captain, to deliver it to Genji.

units.source_text: 信中说了许多感慨的话，一端附诗云：

en.t: In the letter he wrote many words of feeling, and at one point added this poem:
